summary: Keep receipt advancing when generation rediscovery is incomplete below the graph frontier.

replay.detail: The receipt runtime requires a complete generation-qualified discovery proof for the entire admitted replay range. Missing, partial or invalidated proof records durable deferral instead of requesting an automatic replay that the writer fence would reject.

rules.detail: Canonical operation and graph fold semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Direct low-level projection calls retain replay guard decisions for uncommitted ranges; the Runtime adapter owns strict receipt discovery and automatic fallback safety.

manual.detail: Explicit repair remains required for deferred projections.

recovery.detail: An interrupted early rediscovery page no longer strands later unrelated receipt behind an already-advanced graph frontier. Graph health stays stale while receipt advances.

downtime.detail: No production timing measurement is claimed.
